title: Strategic Djibouti to vote in presidential election
summary: In tonight's edition, Djibouti heads to the polls this weekend in a presidential election widely expected to extend the rule of President Ismaïl Omar Guelleh. Also, Pope Leo is set to become the first head of the Catholic Church to visit Algeria. And the Bijagos Archipelago in Guinea Bissau is now part of UNESCO’s World Heritage List.
